subject.title: Control UI: Debug snapshot refresh has no progress indicator and silently fails when disconnected

question: Should maintainers adopt/rebase the open conflicting fork PR or close/supersede it before allowing a fresh current-main fix for this Debug Snapshots bug?
rationale: The bug is narrow and source-reproducible, but an open fork PR still closes this issue while being conflicting and not maintainer-editable, so automation should not create a competing fix until maintainers choose the PR path.

options.title: Supersede fork and fix fresh
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR, then allow a fresh narrow fix against the current Debug page/view files.

options.title: Adopt and rebase fork
options.body: Have a maintainer or contributor rebase the fork work and repair it for the current localized route-owned Debug view.

options.title: Wait on fork author
options.body: Keep this issue blocked on the existing fork PR, accepting that no new ClawSweeper fix should be queued meanwhile.

recommendation.title: Supersede fork and fix fresh
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR, then allow a fresh narrow fix against the current Debug page/view files.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history on both the original Debug dashboard behavior and the current route-owned Debug files.
